plugins.name: holomime
plugins.description: Behavioral alignment for AI agents — diagnose drift, run therapy sessions, benchmark personality

skills.name: autopilot
skills.description: Automatically diagnose behavioral drift, run a therapy session, and apply corrections to the personality spec. Hands-off alignment — one command to detect and fix behavioral issues. Requires holomime Pro.
skills.description_zh: 自动诊断 AI 行为漂移、运行行为矫正会话并修改人格规格，需 holomime Pro；这里的 therapy 指 AI 行为处理。

skills.name: benchmark
skills.description: Stress-test an AI agent's behavioral alignment with 8 adversarial scenarios. Produces a grade (A-F) and score (0-100). Use when you want to know how well an agent handles apology traps, sycophancy tests, boundary pushes, error recovery, and more.
skills.description_zh: 用八个对抗场景压力测试 AI 行为对齐，涵盖道歉陷阱、迎合、边界与错误恢复，输出 A至F等级和0至100分。

skills.name: brain
skills.description: Launch a 3D real-time visualization of an AI agent's behavioral patterns. Opens a browser at localhost:3838 showing the NeuralSpace brain with 9 regions lighting up as behavioral patterns fire. Use when you want to visually monitor agent behavior or capture a shareable snapshot.
skills.description_zh: 启动 localhost:3838 的三维实时 NeuralSpace 行为视图，九个区域随 AI 行为模式点亮，用于监控或分享快照。

skills.name: diagnose
skills.description: Detect behavioral drift patterns in AI agent conversations. Use when you want to check if an agent is over-apologizing, hedging, being sycophantic, violating boundaries, error-spiraling, sentiment-skewing, drifting formality, or hallucinating. Zero LLM cost — rule-based detection with 80+ signals across 8 detectors.
skills.description_zh: 通过八个规则检测器的80多个信号识别 AI 对话中过度道歉、含糊、迎合、越界、错误循环、情绪偏斜、正式程度漂移与幻觉，原文称不产生 LLM 成本。

skills.name: profile
skills.description: Display a human-readable summary of an AI agent's personality spec. Use when you want to see Big Five traits, communication style, domain boundaries, and growth areas at a glance.
skills.description_zh: 以易读摘要显示 AI 人格规格，包括大五人格、沟通风格、领域边界与改进方向。

skills.name: session
skills.description: Run a structured behavioral therapy session for an AI agent. Uses a 7-phase clinical protocol (rapport, exploration, presenting problem, challenge, skill building, integration, closing) with dual-LLM architecture. Generates DPO training pairs as a byproduct. Requires holomime Pro.
skills.description_zh: 用双 LLM 架构按关系建立、探索、问题、挑战、技能建设、整合、结束七阶段运行 AI 行为矫正会话，并生成 DPO 训练对；需 Pro，不是人类心理治疗。
